description: This file defines an abstract class 'Signing' related to AWS cryptographic request signing, extending NativeResource, including static methods for AWS request signing and signature verification within the AWS CRT PHP SDK.

classes.name: Signing
classes.description: An abstract class providing static methods for AWS request signing and verification, extending NativeResource.
